theorems.name: CryptoSignature.mk.inj
theorems.statement: ∀ {hash : Hash} {signer : String} {timestamp : ℕ} {hash_1 : Hash} {signer_1 : String} {timestamp_1 : ℕ},   { hash := hash, signer := signer, timestamp := timestamp } =       { hash := hash_1, signer := signer_1, timestamp := timestamp_1 } →     hash = hash_1 ∧ signer = signer_1 ∧ timestamp = timestamp_1

theorems.name: CryptoSignature.mk.injEq
theorems.statement: ∀ (hash : Hash) (signer : String) (timestamp : ℕ) (hash_1 : Hash) (signer_1 : String) (timestamp_1 : ℕ),   ({ hash := hash, signer := signer, timestamp := timestamp } =       { hash := hash_1, signer := signer_1, timestamp := timestamp_1 }) =     (hash = hash_1 ∧ signer = signer_1 ∧ timestamp = timestamp_1)

theorems.name: CryptoSignature.mk.sizeOf_spec
theorems.statement: ∀ (hash : Hash) (signer : String) (timestamp : ℕ),   sizeOf { hash := hash, signer := signer, timestamp := timestamp } = 1 + sizeOf hash + sizeOf signer + sizeOf timestamp

theorems.name: DualSignature.mk.inj
theorems.statement: ∀ {shiva seth shiva_1 seth_1 : CryptoSignature},   { shiva := shiva, seth := seth } = { shiva := shiva_1, seth := seth_1 } → shiva = shiva_1 ∧ seth = seth_1

theorems.name: DualSignature.mk.injEq
theorems.statement: ∀ (shiva seth shiva_1 seth_1 : CryptoSignature),   ({ shiva := shiva, seth := seth } = { shiva := shiva_1, seth := seth_1 }) = (shiva = shiva_1 ∧ seth = seth_1)

theorems.name: DualSignature.mk.sizeOf_spec
theorems.statement: ∀ (shiva seth : CryptoSignature), sizeOf { shiva := shiva, seth := seth } = 1 + sizeOf shiva + sizeOf seth
